ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Square $S_{1}$ is $1\times 1$. For $i\ge 1,$ the lengths of the sides of square $S_{i+1}$ are half the lengths of the sides of square $S_{i},$ two adjacent sides of square $S_{i}$ are perpendicular bisectors of two adjacent sides of square $S_{i+1},$ and the other two sides of square $S_{i+1},$ are the perpendicular bisectors of two adjacent sides of square $S_{i+2}$. The total area enclosed by at least one of $S_{1}, S_{2}, S_{3}, S_{4}, S_{5}$ can be written in the form $m/n,$ where $m$ and $n$ are relatively prime positive integers. Find $m-n$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a string of squares rotated in the same direction, with sizes successively halved, arranged from left to right. Each square has only one small diamond-shaped overlapping region with the next adjacent square; from the figure it can be seen that non-adjacent squares are separated from each other, have no common region, and there is no region where three squares overlap at the same time. Then reason: According to the problem statement, the side length of S1 is 1, and after that the side length of each square is halved, so the side lengths from S1 to S5 are respectively 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16. The corresponding areas are 1, 1/4, 1/16, 1/64, 1/256. According to the perpendicular bisector condition, for each pair of adjacent squares S_i and S_{i+1}, two adjacent sides of the larger square are the perpendicular bisectors of two adjacent sides of the smaller square, so these two sides pass through the center of the smaller square and enclose one quadrant of the smaller square. Therefore the overlapping area of S_i and S_{i+1} is 1/4 of the area of S_{i+1}. The adjacent overlapping areas are in order: S1∩S2 = 1/16, S2∩S3 = 1/64, S3∩S4 = 1/256, S4∩S5 = 1/1024. From the image it can be known that non-adjacent squares do not overlap, therefore there is no higher-order overlap correction. Union area = sum of areas - sum of adjacent overlapping areas: (1 + 1/4 + 1/16 + 1/64 + 1/256) - (1/16 + 1/64 + 1/256 + 1/1024). The first part is 341/256 = 1364/1024; the second part is 85/1024. So the union area is 1279/1024. Therefore m = 1279, n = 1024, m - n = 255.

method.method_draft: Use direct inclusion-exclusion over the five squares. From the side-halving condition, the side lengths are 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, so the individual areas are 1, 1/4, 1/16, 1/64, 1/256. The perpendicular-bisector condition means that for each consecutive pair, the two relevant sides of the larger square are the two midlines of the smaller square, so their intersection is the center of the smaller square; hence exactly one quadrant of S_{i+1} lies inside S_i. Therefore area(S_i ∩ S_{i+1}) = (1/4)area(S_{i+1}). The chaining clause and the picture show that nonconsecutive squares do not overlap, so there are no triple-overlap corrections. Compute union area as sum of the five areas minus the four consecutive overlap areas, then reduce to m/n and compute m-n.

Each square has only one small diamond-shaped overlapping region with the next adjacent square; from the figure it can be seen that non-adjacent squares are separated from each other, have no common region, and there is no region where three squares overlap at the same time.

According to the perpendicular bisector condition, for each pair of adjacent squares S_i and S_{i+1}, two adjacent sides of the larger square are the perpendicular bisectors of two adjacent sides of the smaller square, so these two sides pass through the center of the smaller square and enclose one quadrant of the smaller square. Therefore the overlapping area of S_i and S_{i+1} is 1/4 of the area of S_{i+1}.

The adjacent overlapping areas are in order: S1∩S2 = 1/16, S2∩S3 = 1/64, S3∩S4 = 1/256, S4∩S5 = 1/1024. From the image it can be known that non-adjacent squares do not overlap, therefore there is no higher-order overlap correction.

Union area = sum of areas - sum of adjacent overlapping areas:
(1 + 1/4 + 1/16 + 1/64 + 1/256) - (1/16 + 1/64 + 1/256 + 1/1024).
The first part is 341/256 = 1364/1024; the second part is 85/1024. So the union area is 1279/1024.
